awards.module.name: Awards
awards.module.description: The honours the theatre gives, such as fellowships and commendations, who holds them, and the ticket price an award may carry.
awards.settings.roll.public.label: Show the roll of honour on the public site
awards.settings.roll.public.help: The page at /awards and the roll in the theatre's own pages. Each holder still chooses whether their own award is listed.
awards.settings.issuing.tell-recipient.l: Tell somebody when they are given an award
awards.settings.issuing.tell-recipient.h: Sends the recipient a message with a link to their awards when one is issued to their account.
awards.abilities.type.view.label: See the kinds of award the theatre gives
awards.abilities.type.manage.label: Create, change, archive and delete kinds of award
awards.abilities.award.view.label: See who holds which award, with the citation and the decision
awards.abilities.award.issue.label: Issue an award the committee has decided
awards.abilities.award.update.label: Correct an award's wording, date and where it is listed
awards.abilities.award.revoke.label: Revoke an award
awards.abilities.award.check.label: Check whether somebody else holds an award, at the desk or the door
awards.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change awards settings
awards.navigation.types.label: Award types
awards.navigation.awards.label: Awards
awards.navigation.mine.label: My awards
awards.record-tabs.account.label: Awards
awards.screens.types.help: The kinds of award the theatre gives, such as a fellowship or a commendation. Each says whether it carries a ticket price.
awards.screens.types.empty-help: Add the first, such as Fellowship, then issue it to the people who hold it.
awards.screens.type.name: Name
awards.screens.type.name-help: What the award is called wherever it is shown, such as Fellowship.
awards.screens.type.key-help: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens, such as fellowship. Used in web addresses and imports.
awards.screens.type.key-fixed: The short code cannot change once the award has been issued.
awards.screens.type.summary-help: A sentence or two shown beside the award on the roll.
awards.screens.type.ticket-benefit: Holders may buy the award's ticket price
awards.screens.type.ticket-benefit-help: The price itself is set in the box office, on each show's tickets.
awards.screens.type.one-per-person: A person can hold it only once
awards.screens.type.one-per-person-help: Leave this off for an award that can be won again, such as a yearly commendation.
awards.screens.type.default-visibility: Where a new award is listed
awards.screens.type.default-visibility-h: What each award of this type starts as. Its holder can change their own.
awards.screens.type.nominations-help: Attach a published form for people to nominate somebody for this award. Put "Issue the award" on the form's approving move and the award is issued when a nomination is approved.
awards.screens.type.retire-help: Archiving stops it being issued. Awards already given stay as they are.
awards.screens.type.restore-help: This award type is archived. Restore it to issue it again.
awards.screens.type.confirm-archive: It can no longer be issued. Awards already given stay as they are.
awards.screens.type.confirm-delete: It has never been issued, so nothing else is lost.
awards.screens.awards.no-types-help: Create an award type first, such as Fellowship, then issue it to the people who hold it.
awards.screens.awards.empty-help: Issue one once the committee has decided it.
awards.screens.issue.title: Issue an award
awards.screens.issue.help: Record an award the committee has decided.
awards.screens.issue.who-person-help: Find them by name or email address.
awards.screens.issue.who-new-help: An account is made for their email address, which they can sign in to.
awards.screens.issue.who-name-help: For a past award. It is listed, and carries no ticket price until an account is linked.
awards.screens.issue.name: Name on the award
awards.screens.issue.name-help: As it should appear on the roll.
awards.screens.issue.name-help-person: Leave empty to use the name on their account.
awards.screens.issue.address-help: Used to find their account, or to make one.
awards.screens.award.awarded-for-help: A short line, such as an activity or a role. Leave empty when the award is for a show (under More details).
awards.screens.award.production-help: The show the award is for, if it is for one.
awards.screens.award.citation-help: The words read out or printed with the award. Shown wherever the award is listed.
awards.screens.award.decision-note-help: Such as the meeting and the vote. Staff only.
awards.screens.award.listed-help: The holder can change this for themselves in My awards.
awards.screens.award.not-linked: No account is linked to this award
awards.screens.award.not-linked-help: It is listed by name only, and carries no ticket price.
awards.screens.award.revoke-help: The award leaves the roll and stops carrying its ticket price. This cannot be undone here; issue it again if it was a mistake.
awards.screens.mine.help: What the theatre has given you, and where each is listed.
awards.screens.mine.listed-help: Your choice stands over the theatre's.
awards.screens.import.title: Import past awards
awards.screens.import.help: Records awards already given, from a file. Nobody is told.
awards.screens.import.file-help: One award a row: name, date or year awarded, what it was for, citation, email address. Only the name and the date are needed. A year alone is kept as 1 January.
awards.screens.import.reasons.bad-date: the date could not be read
awards.screens.import.reasons.not-an-add: the email address could not be read
awards.screens.import.queued-help: They appear in the list over the next minute or so.
awards.screens.link.title: Link an account
awards.screens.link.help: The holder then sees the award in My awards, and it carries its ticket price if it has one.
awards.forms.nomination.label: Nominations for an award
awards.forms.source.label: Award types
awards.forms.issue-award.label: Issue the award
awards.forms.nomination-template.name: Nomination for an award
awards.forms.nomination-template.descrip: Asks who is nominated, what for and why. Giving the award issues it to the person named.
awards.roll.title: Roll of honour
awards.roll.description: The people the theatre has honoured.
